src.bungie: [Grenade]  : Throw an explosive device energized with [Strand] Strand matter and [Arc] Arc energy that detonates in a supercharged suspending burst. The suspended target takes heavy damage over time and chains jolting lightning to any nearby targets.
src.compendium:
Prismatic Grenade
Explosive charged with Arc and Strand energy.
Explodes in a supercharged suspending burst, dealing up to 105 [?] damage, and inflicting Suspension to enemies within ? meters.
Suspended Enemies are dealt ? damage every ? seconds for ? seconds, and are inflicted Jolt.

src.bungie: Rapidly defeating targets with Light or Darkness damage or Super final blows generates an Elemental pickup of the matching damage type.
src.clarity:
Scoring a Super Kill or Killing 3 enemies with Elemental Damage within 6 seconds of each spawns an Elemental Pickup.
The type of Elemental Pickup is determined by the Damage Type of the final Kill.
5 second cooldown between spawning the same Pickup again. Spawned Tangles share the 12 second global spawn cooldown with the Fragment.
Kills with the element of the spawned Pickup while the cooldown is active do not count towards spawning another Elemental Pickup.
Elemental Pickups include Firesprites, Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, Tangles, and Void Breaches.

src.bungie: Rapidly defeating targets with Light damage grants melee energy. Rapidly defeating targets with Darkness damage grants grenade energy.
src.clarity:
Scoring 3 Kills within 3? seconds of each with Light-aligned damage grants 10% Melee energy.
Scoring 3 Kills within 3? seconds of each with Dark-aligned damage grants 10% Grenade energy.
Light Alignment: Arc, Solar, Void
Darkness Alignment: Stasis, Strand

src.bungie: Melee final blows start health regeneration. While transcendent, melee final blows start health regeneration for you and nearby allies.
src.clarity:
Melee Kills start health regeneration.
While Transcendent, this also applies to allies within ? meters.

src.bungie: Defeating targets with grenade final blows grants Volatile Rounds to your [Void] Void weapons. Defeating targets with powered melee final blows grants Unraveling Rounds to your [Strand] Strand weapons.
src.clarity:
Grenade Kills grant Volatile Rounds to Void Weapons for 11 [7.5] seconds.
Powered Melee Kills (including Knockout) grant Unraveling Rounds to Strand Weapons for 11 [7.5] seconds.

src.bungie:
Freezing or suppressing a target reloads your equipped weapons and increases weapon stability, aim assist, and airborne effectiveness.

Defeating frozen or suppressed targets creates a Stasis Shard or Void Breach.
src.clarity:
Freezing or Suppressing an enemy refills your readied weapon's magazine from reserves and grants 20? Stability, ? Aim Assist, and 40 Airborne Effectiveness for 11 seconds.
4 second cooldown between activations.
Killing Frozen or Suppressed Enemies spawns a Stasis Shard or Void Breach respectively.

src.bungie: Your [Arc] Arc, [Solar] Solar, and [Void] Void abilities deal increased damage to targets afflicted with Darkness debuffs.
src.clarity:
Light abilities deal 10% increased damage to enemies affected by Stasis or Strand elemental debuffs.
Light Melee Abilities in PVE instead deal an additional 50% of their base damage.

src.bungie: Powered melee hits against targets makes you radiant. Powered melee final blows make you and nearby allies radiant.
src.clarity:
Elemental Melee Hits grant you Radiant for 5 seconds.
Elemental Melee Kills grant you and allies within ? meters Radiant for 5 seconds.

src.bungie: Finishers create a detonation that either jolts, scorches, slows, severs, or makes targets volatile based on the damage type of your equipped Super.
src.clarity:
Finishers trigger an Elemental explosion that deals up to 135 Super-Matching Elemental Damage and applies a Super-Matching Elemental Debuff in a ? meter radius.
Elemental Debuffs applied:
• Arc: Jolt
• Solar: x40 Scorch
• Void: Volatile
• Stasis: x? Slow for ? seconds
• Strand: Sever for ? seconds

src.bungie: Defeating targets afflicted with [Stasis] Stasis or [Strand] Strand debuffs grants bonus Light Transcendence energy.
src.clarity:
Killing enemies affected by Stasis or Strand Elemental debuffs grants additional Light Transcendence Energy:
• Minors: 1%
• Elites: 3%
• Minibosses and higher: 5%
• Players: ?%

src.bungie: Your Void grenades weaken targets, and your Arc grenades jolt targets.
src.clarity:
Void Grenade Ability damage applies Weaken for 6 [?] seconds.
Arc Grenade Ability damage applies Jolt.

src.bungie: Defeating targets while transcendent creates Orbs of Power for your allies.
src.clarity:
Kills while Transcendent spawn up to 4 Orbs of Power for allies that grant 7.15?% Super Energy.
Orbs spawn upon passing specific point thresholds: 30, 50, 70, and 100 points for each orb.
Points gained per Kill by Enemy Rank:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 10 points
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 15 points
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 20 points
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites: 34 points
• T4 Elites, Minibosses: 40 points
• Bosses: 50 points
• Players: ? points

src.bungie: Defeating targets with Kinetic weapons grants you bonus Transcendence energy. Defeating targets with your Super grants you and nearby allies bonus Transcendence energy.
src.clarity:
Kinetic Weapon Kills grant an additional 2% [?%] Light and Darkness Transcendence energy.
Super Kills grant an additional 2% [?%] Light and Darkness Transcendence Energy to you and allies within ? metres.

src.bungie: Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants Transcendence energy of the same type.
src.clarity:
Collecting Elemental Pickups or destroying a Tangle grants additional Transcendence Energy of the matching alignment:
• Ionic Traces, Firesprites, Void Breaches: 7.5% Light Transcendence Energy
• Stasis Shards: 5% Darkness Transcendence Energy
• Tangles: 10% Darkness Transcendence Energy

src.bungie: While you have an elemental buff, your class ability regenerates more quickly.
src.clarity:
Having an active elemental buff grants an additional 40% Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate.
Having 2+ active elemental buffs grants an additional 60% instead.

src.bungie: While transcendent, your ability final blows explode.
src.clarity: Ability Kills while Transcendent trigger an explosion that deals up to 130 [?] Ability-Matching Elemental damage in a ? meter radius.

src.bungie: Grenade final blows cure you. Transcendence grenade final blows increase the strength of the effect.
src.clarity:
Grenade Ability Kills grant you Cure x1.
Prismatic Grenade Kills grant you Cure x2.

src.bungie: While surrounded by combatants, you are more resistant to incoming damage. While transcendent, the effect is increased.
src.clarity:
Grants 15% [?%] Damage Resistance while within 15 meters of 3 enemies.
The Damage Resistance is NOT increased while Transcendent, it simply stacks with Transcendence's 20% Damage Resistance for a total of 32%.

src.bungie: Picking up an Orb of Power grants either Bolt Charge, Restoration, Frost Armor, Woven Mail, or Overshield based on the damage type of your equipped Super.
src.clarity:
Collecting Orbs of Power grants Elemental buffs based on your equipped Super's element:
• Arc: 1 Bolt Charge Stack
• Solar: Restoration x1 for 5 seconds
• Void: 22.5 HP Overshield for 5 seconds
• Stasis: 2 Frost Armor Stacks for 9 seconds
• Strand: Woven Mail for 5 seconds

src.bungie: Increases the size and damage of the burst when you shatter a Stasis crystal or frozen target, and increases the area of effect of Solar ignitions.
src.clarity:
Ignitions have a 25% increased blast radius.
Shattering enemies or destroying Crystals creates an additional damage instance, dealing up to 25 [9] damage in a 10 [8] meter radius.
Damage falls off to 17 [4] damage at the edge of the radius.

src.bungie: While you have an Arc, Solar, or Void buff, ability final blows grant bonus Darkness Transcendence energy.
src.clarity: Ability Kills with an active Arc, Solar, or Void Elemental buff grant an additional 1% [?%] Darkness Transcendence Energy.

src.bungie: Landing rapid precision hits emits a severing blast from the target. While transcendent, the severing blast is bigger.
src.clarity:
Scoring multiple Precision Hits within 3 seconds of each causes your next damage instance within 3 seconds (from any source) to trigger a Severing Burst.
Severing Burst applies Sever to enemies in a 3 meter radius. Radius is increased to 6 meters while Transcendent.
Further Precision Hits within 4 seconds of an activation provide no activation progress.
Precision Hits required to prepare the Severing Burst:
• 20% of magazine size rounded down + 1
• Bows require 2 hits

src.bungie: [Grenade]  : Throw a mass of [Void] Void energy and [Stasis] Stasis matter. On impact, deploys a miniature black hole orbited by a slowing field. After a short duration, the black hole implodes, suppressing and dealing heavy damage to all nearby targets.
src.compendium:
Prismatic Grenade
Deals up to 70 [26] Void Damage on impact, pulling enemies within 12 meters towards it, and creating a miniature black hole orbited by a halo of slowing ice.
The slowing field deals 18 [4] Stasis Damage and inflicts x13? Slow every 0.25 seconds for 3.65 seconds to enemies within 6 meters.
After 5 seconds of impacting, the black hole implodes, infliction suppression and dealing up to 570 [150] Void Damage to enemies within 7 meters.

src.bungie: [Grenade]  : Throw a device charged with [Stasis] Stasis matter and [Solar] Solar energy that attaches to surfaces or targets, then erupts into a slowing storm. After a short duration, the device ignites, creating a deadly scorching cyclone.
src.compendium:
Prismatic Grenade
Attaches to surfaces or enemies, releasing a torrent of Stasis and Solar energy in a cone up to ? meters away.
Erupts into a slowing storm, dealing up to 78 [?] damage upon erupting.
Slowing storm deals 15.6 [?] Stasis Damage and inflicts x13? Slow every 0.25 seconds for 3.45 seconds.
After 3.45 seconds of attaching, it releases a scorching cyclone that deals 39 [?] Solar Damage and inflicts x10 Scorch every 0.25 seconds for 4 seconds.

src.bungie:
Achieve harmony by dealing damage with Light and Dark damage types in equal measure or by applying subclass buffs to your allies. Kinetic damage generates both Light and Dark energy.

While Transcendence is active, your grenade is replaced by a unique Prismatic grenade that deals both Light and Dark damage. Dealing melee damage while transcendent greatly increases your grenade energy regeneration, and vice versa. Defeating targets while transcendent extends its duration.
src.compendium:
Unique ability obtained upon utilizing enough Light and Darkness damage types.
Kinetic Damage fills both Light and Darkness bars at 50% decreased rate. Overkill Damage isn't counted for Transcendence gains.
Having one full Alignment bar makes Kinetic Damage fill the remaining bar with at 40% decreased rate.
Dealing damage, alongside applying Elemental Effects grants Transcendence Energy. 
Applying Elemental Effects, both buffs and debuffs, grant Transcendence Energy to their corresponding alignment.
Transcendence:
Instantly recharges 2 Grenade and Melee Ability Charges on activation.
Replaces Grenade Ability with an unique class-specific Prismatic Grenade Ability with Light and Darkness damage types.
Grants 5% Increased Weapon Damage, an additional 10% Grenade and Melee Regeneration Speed, and 20% [5%] Damage Resist for 20 seconds.
Damage Increase stacks with everything.
Dealing Grenade Ability Damage while Transcendent increases the Melee Regeneration Speed to 35% Fixed Melee Ability Energy per second for 2 seconds.
Dealing Melee Ability Damage while Transcendent increases the Prismatic Grenade Regeneration Speed to 35% Prismatic Grenade Ability Energy per second for 2 seconds.
Kills while Transcendent extend its duration, with the amount extended decreasing as more kills are scored.
Tier 1 and T2 Combatants = 5% | T3 and T4 = 10% | T3 Elites, Minibosses and Bosses = 15% | Guardians = ?%
Each kill after the first gets a cumulative 0.9?x penalty to the duration extension.
